ABOUT NESTMATCH

Your housing search, organized.

Our free rental planning guides and cost comparison calculator can be used for housing searches anywhere in the United States, for short or long stays. They do not depend on local listing coverage.

NestMatch is a free rental-shortlist prototype. Set your preferences, swipe through fictional Los Angeles homes, and compare saved options with private notes and progress labels. It is not a live marketplace or an all-platform search engine.

How ranking works

Known must-have mismatches are excluded. Remaining samples are ordered by matching preferences, then estimated monthly cost. Unknown costs and features are shown explicitly, and you can exclude them. Python and SQLite build the sample inventory; browser code applies preferences locally. Personal notes do not affect ranking.

The previous reciprocal-matching demo remains available with its local profile and photo controls. Its stored data has not been migrated or deleted.

What this demo is—and is not

The listings, images, and dates are illustrative sample data. NestMatch does not publish real addresses, perform screening, accept rent, or contact anyone. Profile details, photos, preferences, and decisions remain on your device.
